112.hindi_meaning_context: एक बड़ा स्टोर जहाँ खाने-पीने और घरेलू इस्तेमाल का सामान मिलता है।

112.english_meaning: The action of making or manufacturing goods from raw materials.
112.hindi_meaning: उत्पादन; कच्चे माल से वस्तुएं तैयार करने की प्रक्रिया।
112.example: Many workers help in the production of clothes along the market chain.
112.hindi_meaning_context: उत्पादन; कच्चे माल से वस्तुएं तैयार करने की प्रक्रिया।

112.english_meaning: A person involved in wholesale trade, buying and selling goods in large quantities.
112.hindi_meaning: व्यापारी; जो बड़े पैमाने पर वस्तुओं का क्रय-विक्रय करता है।
112.example: Garment exporters buy the cloth from merchants to make shirts.
112.hindi_meaning_context: व्यापारी; जो बड़े पैमाने पर वस्तुओं का क्रय-विक्रय करता है।

112.english_meaning: A person or spinning mill that turns raw cotton into thread or yarn.
112.hindi_meaning: कताईकार; जो कपास से धागा या सूत बनाता है।
112.example: The spinning mill buys raw cotton and turns it into yarn.
112.hindi_meaning_context: कताईकार; जो कपास से धागा या सूत बनाता है।

112.english_meaning: A person who weaves fabric or cloth from yarn on a loom.
112.hindi_meaning: बुनकर या जुलाहा; जो सूत या धागे से कपड़ा बुनता है।
112.example: Yarn dealers give the yarn to the weavers to make cloth.
112.hindi_meaning_context: बुनकर या जुलाहा; जो सूत या धागे से कपड़ा बुनता है।

112.english_meaning: The action of subtracting or taking away an amount from a total.
112.hindi_meaning: कटौती; कुल राशि में से किसी खर्च या हिस्से को घटाना।
112.example: Profit is calculated after the deduction of all production costs.
112.hindi_meaning_context: कटौती; कुल राशि में से किसी खर्च या हिस्से को घटाना।

113.english_meaning: A list of books, articles, or websites used as sources of information for a piece of writing or research.
113.hindi_meaning: संदर्भ सूची (पुस्तकों या स्रोतों की सूची)
113.example: The research paper ended with a detailed list of references.

113.english_meaning: Relating to the advocacy of women's rights on the basis of the equality of the sexes.
113.example: Sultana's Dream is regarded as a pioneering feminist work of literature.

113.english_meaning: The process by which businesses or other organizations develop international influence or start operating on an international scale.
113.hindi_meaning: वैश्वीकरण (विश्व स्तर पर आर्थिक और सांस्कृतिक एकीकरण)
113.example: Globalization has significantly impacted women workers in both formal and informal sectors.

113.english_meaning: Done in accordance with rules, conventions, or official regulations, especially in employment or education.
113.example: Many women struggle to find stable jobs within the formal sector.

113.english_meaning: Not officially registered, regulated, or protected by standard labor laws and contracts.
113.hindi_meaning: अनौपचारिक (बिना किसी आधिकारिक अनुबंध या नियम के)
113.example: Workers in the informal sector often lack social security and fixed wages.

113.english_meaning: A period of temporary economic decline during which trade and industrial activity are reduced.
113.example: The small-scale industry faced severe challenges due to market recession.

113.english_meaning: Able to be maintained at a certain rate or level without depleting natural resources or harming the environment.
113.hindi_meaning: धारणीय / संपोषणीय (जो बिना नुकसान पहुँचाए लंबे समय तक चले)
113.example: Governments worldwide are working towards achieving Sustainable Development Goals.

113.english_meaning: Moral principles that govern a person's behavior or the conducting of an activity.
113.example: Medical professionals must strictly follow the regulations and ethics set by the council.

113.english_meaning: A rule or directive made and maintained by an authority.
113.example: New rules and regulations were introduced to improve workplace safety.
Access to healthcare and essential medicines is a fundamental right.

114.english_meaning: The state or fact of having a duty to deal with something or of having control over someone.
114.example: The responsibility for the correctness of the report rests with the publisher.

114.english_meaning: Relating to the land or waters belonging to or controlled by a country.
114.hindi_meaning: क्षेत्रीय (किसी देश के अधिकार क्षेत्र से संबंधित)
114.example: The territorial waters of a country extend a certain distance into the sea.

114.english_meaning: Associated with sailors, navigation, or the sea, especially used in measuring distances at sea.
114.hindi_meaning: समुद्री (समुद्री मील या नौवहन से संबंधित)
114.example: The ship sailed twelve nautical miles away from the coastline.

114.english_meaning: Relating to the running of a business, organization, or government department.
114.example: The administrative headquarters of the state are located in the capital city.

114.english_meaning: The main offices of an organization or the center of operations.
114.example: The administrative headquarters of Chandigarh serve both Haryana and Punjab.

114.english_meaning: Existing or carried on between two or more states.
114.hindi_meaning: अंतर-राज्यीय (दो या दो से अधिक राज्यों के बीच)
114.example: The interstate boundaries between the two neighboring states are clearly marked on the map.

114.english_meaning: The action of organizing something again or differently, typically a company or system.
114.example: The Act of Parliament led to the reorganisation of the North Eastern Areas.

114.english_meaning: Make sure or demonstrate that something is true, accurate, or justified.
114.example: The boundary details on the map have yet to be officially verified.

114.english_meaning: Coming from or situated on the outside.
114.example: The external boundaries of India are marked precisely on the survey map.

114.english_meaning: The outline or boundary of a coast where the land meets the sea.
114.example: India has a vast and varied coastline stretching along the Arabian Sea and the Bay of Bengal.
